approach: Original PS4 x86-64 game code running directly on Windows through replacement PS4 system libraries and a Vulkan renderer derived from shadPS4
notes: Public native Windows release with TRG launcher, direct installation from the user's own compatible PS4 package, 60 FPS gameplay, rendering up to 4K, SMAA, anisotropic filtering, FSR1/RCAS, GPU selection and Xbox controller support. No game files are included.
